name: playwright-gallery
description: Interactive gallery and showcase application for Playwright testing framework

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix demo-site
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:demo"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run build:demo
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:demo"
